Connectivity diagnostic

Local-only network test, not multiplayer gameplay. No scores or browser records are written. Use two tabs or browser sessions. Both should select the intended transport.

No room. The host creates one and shares its invitation with the second browser.

After admission, click Connect in both browsers. The host starts negotiation automatically. Reconnect must also be requested in both browsers; it is a controlled test, not automatic game recovery. Forced modes must report relay candidates on both ends; TURN/TCP or TLS still uses UDP relay allocations.

Not connected.
